description: This file defines the PersistentStateAttributeMapper class, which maps persistent state attributes to factory instances within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for creating persistent state objects based on attribute parameters and configuration.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: A class that maps persistent state attributes to factory instances, enabling the creation of persistent state objects based on attribute parameters.

classes.name: PersistentStateConfiguration
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IPersistentStateConfiguration, holding configuration details such as StateName and StorageName.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a factory function for generating persistent state objects based on the provided parameter info and attribute.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: A static helper method that invokes the factory method to create a persistent state object using the provided context, method info, and configuration.
